comment: Read from the maker's source at commit 4120a74, the head of main. Every commit in the repository carries version 2.0.0, so the version string settles nothing; the installed build is the post-rebrand one, because the installed plugin.json has slug MissingMileModular and model DoubleplusPulses, which are the names introduced by eb7c34b, and the only two commits after that touch README.md alone. src/ is unchanged from 095f204 onward. The panel prints CLK, not CLOCK as the README's control table and the maker's configured port name both have it; the lines use CLK. The panel prints AND above, MUTE in the middle and OR below, between the two bus toggles, and the constants agree: MODE_AND is 2, which res-src/rotate_befaco.py documents as the up throw of the stock Befaco lever, and MODE_OR is 0, the down throw. A comment in DoubleplusPulsesWidget says the opposite, 'OR up / MUTE centre / AND down'; it contradicts both the constants and the panel and is a stale comment rather than behaviour. The maker tags the module Expander, but it is not one in Rack's sense: it reads no expander bus and has no side to be placed on. Ten lights are configured and none of them has a ParamWidget, so none is clickable; the two that matter to using the module are covered by Note lines. Index order and panel order agree for the routing toggles, which run 1 to 8 down the panel zig-zagging between two columns, and for the two bus toggles and two outputs, which run left to right as A then B.
